item.title: IMD forecasts thunderstorms in plains; Snowfall in Himalayan regions
item.description: A fresh western disturbance is set to transform weather conditions across India, bringing rain and snowfall to Himalayan regions and thunderstorms to northern plains, according to the India Meteorological Department. While north India may see falling temperatures and dense fog, southern coastal areas continue to experience heat and humidity.

item.title: Maha Shivratri 2026 celebrated with auspicious Yogas and devotion across India
item.description: Maha Shivratri 2026 is being celebrated with immense devotion as several auspicious yogas and rajyogas enhance the spiritual importance of the day. Devotees are observing fasts, performing jalabhishek, and offering belpatra and dhatura to Lord Shiva during the four prahar puja timings.

item.title: Will rain disrupt the high-voltage IND vs PAK T20 match? Check Colombo weather report here
item.description: Rain concerns surround the much-awaited India versus Pakistan T20 World Cup match in Colombo, with earlier forecasts predicting heavy showers during evening hours. Updated weather reports now indicate declining rain chances as the night progresses, raising hopes that the match may proceed after a brief delay or interruption.

item.title: Missing Indian student found dead in California after six days; Probe underway
item.description: An Indian student from Karnataka, Saket Srinivasayya, was found dead in California six days after going missing near the University of California, Berkeley campus. The Indian Consulate confirmed the recovery and assured support to repatriate the body while local police continue investigating the circumstances.

item.title: Invested in Gold or Silver ETFs? SEBI’s new rules could impact you
item.description: SEBI has proposed sweeping changes to gold and silver ETF pricing rules to curb mispricing and align trading values with real asset prices. The move introduces dynamic price bands, cooling-off periods, and a pre-open session to improve transparency and investor protection.

item.title: ‘Tu Yaa Main’ gets weekend push; Shows growth in Saturday box office collection
item.description: Tu Yaa Main recorded a slight rise in collections on its second day, benefiting from the weekend but still showing an overall weak box-office trend. The film’s total earnings remain modest as strong competition and mixed audience response limit growth.

item.title: IND Vs PAK: Rs 1,600 crore reality behind Pakistan’s decision to face India
item.description: The much-awaited India-Pakistan encounter in the T20 World Cup is not only a sporting spectacle but also a major economic event. From broadcast revenue and sponsorships to soaring ticket, flight, and hotel prices, the match influences multiple industries.

item.title: AI Impact Summit 2026: Delhi Police Issues Traffic Advisory; Details here
item.description: Delhi Police has issued a detailed traffic advisory ahead of the five-day AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi from February 16 to 20 at Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan. Certain roads, including Bhairon Marg and Mathura Road, will be restricted during VVIP movements.

item.title: Kedarnath Dham to reopen on 22 April; Click for important details
item.description: T Gangadhar Ling, acting Chief Priest at Baba Kedarnath Dham, announced the date. This year, the doors of Lord Kedarnath will open on 22 April Wednesday at 8 in the morning during the Taurus ascendant.
